 Comment React Share After his loss to Medvedev, Cobolli's troubling record against the Top 10 on hard courts keeps growing
 Beaten by Daniil Medvedev in his Turin debut, the Italian suffered another loss to a Top 10 player on this surface — a streak that is starting to weigh heavily on his record.
 MASON, OHIO - AUGUST 19: Flavio Cobolli of Italy looks on during a match against Rafael Jodar of Spain on day nine of the Cincinnati Open at Lindner Family Tennis Center on August 19, 2026 in Mason, Ohio. © EMILEE CHINN / Getty Images via AFP Jules Hypolite 16/11/2026, 22:02 2 min to read Follow us ATP Finals Cobolli Turin Flavio Cobolli is still struggling to compete with the best players on the tour on hard courts.
 The Italian once again got a measure of the gap separating him from the elite on this surface on Monday night, in his first match at the ATP Finals.
 Remove ads Cobolli beaten by Medvedev as expected
 Facing Daniil Medvedev, a former champion at the tournament and current world No. 5, the 23-year-old went down in two sets (7-6, 6-3).
 Despite a tightly contested first set, Cobolli never truly managed to unsettle his opponent.
 A record that remains as tough as ever against the Top 10 on hard courts
 This latest defeat adds to an unflattering statistic for Flavio Cobolli. Since the start of his career, the Italian has still never beaten a Top 10 player on hard courts.
 As a statistic published by Jeu, Set et Maths reminds us, he now has eleven losses in such matches, with only two sets won and 25 conceded.
 That list notably includes three defeats against Daniil Medvedev, as well as losses to Novak Djokovic, Jannik Sinner, Ben Shelton and Alex de Minaur.
 The Italian will therefore have to keep waiting for his first win over a Top 10 player on hard courts. He will nevertheless have a great chance to achieve it on Wednesday against Frances Tiafoe, in his second match of this round-robin stage.
